title: Raízen Approves Subsidiary Listing and Expands Capital
seoTitle: Raízen Approves Subsidiary Listing, Expands Capital
subtitle: Shareholders approve listing application for Raízen Energia and increase authorized capital limit
excerpt: Raízen shareholders approved the subsidiary's B3 listing and an authorized capital increase to up to 200 billion shares, key steps in the restructuring.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Last Friday, Raízen Energia shareholders approved the application to list the subsidiary on B3's Level 2 segment, while the board expanded the authorized capital limit to up to 200 billion shares. The decisions are part of the out-of-court restructuring plan to restructure the company's debt.

Raízen Energia Listing on B3 Level 2

The unanimous shareholders' meeting authorized the submission of applications for admission to trading of common shares, preferred shares, and share deposit certificates (units). The move depends on approval from the exchange, which has not yet set a debut date or ticker symbols. Level 2 requires 100% tag-along rights and voting rights for preferred shares on strategic decisions.

Increase in Capital Limit to 200 Billion Shares

At a board meeting, the increase in authorized capital was approved to allow the RSA capitalization—granting of restricted stock awards—up to the new ceiling. The measure is subject to approval at a shareholders' meeting and will lose effect if the resolutive condition occurs.

Capital Reduction of up to R$ 35 Billion

In parallel, the parent company proposed reducing share capital by up to R$ 35 billion, distributing securities of Raízen Energia to shareholders in the same type, class, and proportion as their holdings. The proposal depends on the completion of the listing and the conversion of Resa's registration with the CVM.

Creation of New Class of Preferred Shares

The creation of Class B preferred shares was included on the agenda, with approval requiring a majority vote of preferred shares at a special meeting. Board members nominated by Shell Brazil will be considered elected by the holders of this new class.

Next Steps for Shareholders

The approved measures will be submitted to an extraordinary general meeting and a special meeting of preferred shareholders, both scheduled for October 30. Documents detailing the proposals will be made available alongside the call notice, allowing investors to evaluate the distribution of units and participation in the stages of the restructuring.

With information from Money Times, NovaCana, CNN Brasil.
